description: FROM items apply in TEXTUAL order. A comma LATERAL / TABLE(FLATTEN(...)) written BEFORE an explicit join must be in scope for that join's ON condition - the flatten output is the join's left side - and a lateral written AFTER the joins still sees the joined tables. Before the fix, any explicit join DEFERRED every comma-lateral, so an ON referencing the flatten output matched nothing. The ON may also reference the SELECT-list ALIAS of the flatten output, the vendor idiom. Converted 1:1 from query/LateralBeforeJoinOrderTest (now retired); its second test asserted only a row count, which the converted test states as the rows.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE cards (card_id VARCHAR, labels VARIANT)
CREATE TABLE labels (label_key VARCHAR, label_name VARCHAR)
SELECT c.card_id, t.value::VARCHAR AS label_id, lb.label_name FROM cards AS c, TABLE(FLATTEN(labels)) AS t INNER JOIN labels AS lb ON lb.label_key = t.value::VARCHAR ORDER BY label_id
CREATE TABLE cards (card_id VARCHAR, labels VARIANT)
CREATE TABLE labels (label_key VARCHAR, label_name VARCHAR)
SELECT c.card_id, t.value::VARCHAR AS label_id, lb.label_name FROM cards AS c, TABLE(FLATTEN(labels)) AS t INNER JOIN labels AS lb ON lb.label_key = label_id ORDER BY label_id
CREATE TABLE b_side (k VARCHAR, arr VARIANT)
SELECT a.k, f.value::NUMBER AS v FROM a_side AS a INNER JOIN b_side AS b ON b.k = a.k, TABLE(FLATTEN(b.arr)) AS f ORDER BY v
